title: The 1RB0LE sweepers with E1 = 0RE: the chain law holds up to a defect, and the runs go much further
text: lean/Layers.lean now proves the chain law of the five 1RB0LE two-word sweepers whatever tape follows the last word. In the three siblings with E1 = 0RE the chain later carries defects, places where the tape is out of phase by half a digit, so the law holds on the grammar prefix up to the first defect. Jumping with that, the runs reach about 10<sup>77</sup> (1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_0LC---), 10<sup>85</sup> (1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LA---) and 10<sup>128</sup> (1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---) events with no halt. What a carry does at a defect is open.
